row.evidence: Brex's SCIM integration help article is tagged Premium, Enterprise and Smart card, and the pricing page lists Premium at $12 user/month as the first paid plan above the $0 Essentials plan.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to free: under the methodology the team plan is the lowest paid tier above the free tier, and Essentials is $0/user/month, so the team plan is Premium ($12/user/month), which itself includes SCIM and SAML/OIDC SSO. June recorded Essentials (free) as the team plan; prices are unchanged. The pricing page does not say whether $12 is annual or monthly. SCIM is documented with Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App and an Entra non-gallery app against https://scim.brex.com/v2 with a Brex-generated bearer token; there is no Okta catalogue app with provisioning (Okta's Brex app is SSO only). Deprovisioning is off by default; when enabled, active users are deactivated (dashboard access revoked, cards blocked but not cancelled) and archived/invited users are deleted. The Brex Team API (users, departments, locations, titles, cards) is listed on every plan including Essentials. HRIS sync via Merge is Premium and above.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Google/Microsoft sign-in ('Enterprise IdP login') is on all plans; it is social sign-in, not SAML/OIDC with the customer's IdP.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billing period not stated on the pricing page. Security audit logs (UI) listed from Premium.

deprovision.data_retained: Active users are deactivated and stay visible in the dashboard; dashboard access is revoked and spending blocked on all active cards, but cards are not locked or cancelled so they can be transferred; sole-spender spend limits close. Archived, invited and not-invited users are deleted. Automatic offboarding is off by default.

custom.how: Extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:brex:custom:User:<field> for custom fields (managed in Team > Fields library); urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:brex:User:location for location

roles.how: Roles set by Brex auto-invite rules (based on entity, department, title, etc.), not by an IdP role attribute

limitations.text: Entra must map userName to mail, not userPrincipalName, or Brex cannot match users.
Removing a user in the IdP does not revoke Brex access unless automatic offboarding is enabled.
Restricting SCIM-provisioned users by email domain requires contacting Brex.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filters by status, email, etc.)
Update user, including status (ACTIVE/DISABLED suspend-unsuspend, ARCHIVED, DELETED)

audit_log_api.notes: Pricing page lists 'Security audit logs' on Premium and Enterprise; no audit-log API is in the developer docs index.

rate_limits.text: Up to 1,000 requests in 60 seconds per Client ID and Brex account.

limitations.text: Most APIs require an account admin to create the token; user tokens expire after 90 days without use.

okta.notes: Okta catalogue app is SAML/OIDC/SWA only; Brex documents SCIM through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App.

entra.notes: Brex's SCIM guide uses an Entra non-gallery app; no Microsoft Learn Brex tutorial found (brex-tutorial returned 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS sync through Merge (Premium and above)
